__config_notes__: Persistent extension graph for user-defined WSM modalities and tasks.
String modality identifiers are first-class node names; they do not need to occupy WSG numeric channels.
The custom graph has its own train_log_custom namespace, so its Channel Head indices start from zero.
Each validated custom Head stores its deployment choice directly in recommended_checkpoint; no separate recommendation registry is required.

Universal_Pose.description: Category-independent articulated skeleton visualization on a black background

LayerDiffuse_Transparency.description: RGB-replicated alpha/transparency estimate for a foreground or transparent layer

ICLight_Lighting.description: Three-channel target-light condition, such as an environment or illumination map

ICLight_Relighted_RGB.description: RGB appearance under the target illumination

Channel_Head_000000.target_description: Universal_Pose: category-independent articulated skeleton visualization on a black background

Channel_Head_000001.target_description: LayerDiffuse_Transparency: soft alpha/transparency estimate for the RGB foreground (self-describing named modality, not a WSG numeric channel)

Channel_Head_000002.condition_description: ICLight_Lighting: IBL light-probe condition carrying full per-sample lighting (direction + HDRI environment + point-light highlight) | 0-2: source RGB appearance used as the per-sample reference via the tolerant current-frame fallback (target != 0-2, so this is leakage-free). No caption: like the official inverse_rendering heads (cond=['3','0-2']), relighting is a low-level re-render driven by the probe + RGB reference; object identity/geometry come from the 0-2 reference, lighting from the probe, so text is redundant.
Channel_Head_000002.target_description: ICLight_Relighted_RGB: RGB appearance under the target illumination (self-describing named modality, not a WSG numeric channel)
